findings.title: MetricAlertDetectorHandler is abstract and cannot be instantiated
findings.body: StatefulDetectorHandler declares abstract methods counter_names, get_dedupe_value, get_group_key_values, and build_occurrence_and_event_data. MetricAlertDetectorHandler inherits from it with pass and implements none of them, so it remains an abstract class. MetricAlertFire.detector_handler points to this abstract class, and Detector.detector_handler does group_type.detector_handler(self), so processing any Detector with type 'metric_alert_fire' will raise TypeError when trying to instantiate it. Either implement the stateful detector methods or keep this as a plain DetectorHandler stub until the stateful implementation exists.

findings.title: StatefulDetectorHandler.evaluate docstring still says it returns a list
findings.body: The evaluate method now returns dict[DetectorGroupKey, DetectorEvaluationResult], but its docstring still says it returns a list of DetectorEvaluationResult. This is misleading for implementers and callers and should be updated to match the new contract.

findings.title: Test builds expected occurrence with the wrong group key
findings.body: In TestEvaluateGroupKeyValue.test_dedupe, the expected occurrence is built with group key 'val1', but the evaluate_group_key_value call under test uses group key 'group_key'. The handler's build_occurrence_and_event_data uses the group key it receives to build the fingerprint, so the actual occurrence fingerprint will be '<detector_id>:group_key' while the expected occurrence fingerprint is '<detector_id>:val1'. DetectorEvaluationResult equality compares the result field, so this assertion will fail. Build the expected occurrence with 'group_key' or change the evaluation to use 'val1' consistently.
